description: Flow records an exporter sends, received by a push entry with no script, and the exporter's capture configuration, read by polling. One provider is active at a time. The core joins each record from its own interface indexes, and reads coverage from the configuration, never from the records.

functions.description: Called at every probe round: asks the firewall whether this implementation can be read and whether its configuration serves clients.
functions.name: probe

functions.description: Called at every capture-configuration pass: the exporter's capture configuration now.
functions.name: capture

fields.description: The `result` record.
fields.name: result

fields.description: Why the probe could not finish, when it could not.
fields.name: error

records.description: What `capture` returns: the configuration, or the reason it could not be read.
records.name: capture_answer

fields.description: The `result` record; when the configuration could not be read, its outcome is what the firewall answered.
fields.name: result

fields.description: The configuration read, absent when the read failed.
fields.name: capture

fields.description: Why the read failed, when it did: the configuration is then unreadable, and the core records it so.
fields.name: error

fields.description: Why this exporter's configuration can never be read, when that is so.
fields.name: unsupported

records.description: What the exporter captures and sends.
records.name: capture_configuration

fields.description: Whether the export runs at all.
fields.name: enabled

fields.description: The export protocol's version, as the exporter names it.
fields.name: export_version

fields.description: How long a flow that stays active is accounted before a record of it is exported.
fields.name: active_timeout_seconds

fields.description: How long a flow stays idle before a record of it is exported.
fields.name: inactive_timeout_seconds

fields.description: The `capture_interface` records: every interface the exporter captures on, and nothing else.
fields.name: interfaces

records.description: One interface the exporter captures on.
records.name: capture_interface

fields.description: The interface's configuration identifier, as discovery names it.
fields.name: identifier

fields.description: Whether packets received on the interface are accounted.
fields.name: ingress

fields.description: Whether packets sent on the interface are accounted.
fields.name: egress

fields.description: Whether the exporter actually exports what is configured for the interface, for each captured direction: yes, no (with not_exported_reason), or unknown when it could not be established. Absent is unknown.
fields.name: exported

fields.description: Why the interface is not exported, exactly when exported is no: the provider's own closed name for it.
fields.name: not_exported_reason

fields.description: The identifiers of the interfaces whose received packets this interface's exporter also exports with this interface as the receiving interface. Absent is none.
fields.name: parent_of

records.description: One flow record as the exporter sent it, filled from the push entry's Information Element mapping. Its identity, and what its interface indexes name, are the core's.
records.name: flow_record_record

fields.description: The exporter's address.
fields.name: exporter_address

fields.description: The observation domain (NetFlow v9's source ID).
fields.name: observation_domain

fields.description: The exporter's index of the interface the packets were received on, raw.
fields.name: ingress_interface

fields.description: The exporter's index of the interface the packets were routed to, raw.
fields.name: egress_interface

fields.description: 4 or 6; absent when the exporter sends no version element, the core then reading it from the two addresses, which must agree with it.
fields.name: ip_version

fields.description: The IANA protocol number.
fields.name: protocol

fields.description: The source address.
fields.name: src_address

fields.description: The destination address.
fields.name: dst_address

fields.description: The source port, 0 to 65535; absent for a protocol without ports.
fields.name: src_port

fields.description: The destination port, 0 to 65535; absent for a protocol without ports.
fields.name: dst_port

fields.description: The TCP flags of every packet, ORed together.
fields.name: tcp_flags

fields.description: The octets the record accounts, 0 or more.
fields.name: octets

fields.description: The packets the record accounts, 0 or more.
fields.name: packets

fields.description: The first packet's instant, with the fraction the exporter's precision carries.
fields.name: start_at

fields.description: The last packet's instant, with the fraction the exporter's precision carries.
fields.name: end_at

fields.description: When opnview received the record.
fields.name: received_at
